Title: Adult registration and password storage
Preconditions and data: Public visitor; unique synthetic email; adult donor details and a strong password.
Steps: Submit the donor registration form. Read the saved user and resulting session.
Expected result: One DONOR account contains the submitted profile, password verifies as a hash rather than plaintext, and the donor dashboard is reached.

Title: Age boundary and future birth dates
Preconditions and data: Freeze today to 20 October 2026; DOBs 20/21/19 October 2008 and 1 January 2027.
Steps: Validate a fresh registration form for each DOB.
Expected result: Exactly 18 and older are accepted; one day under 18 and future birth dates are rejected.

Title: Case-insensitive duplicate email
Preconditions and data: Existing jane@example.com; repeat as whitespace-padded JANE@EXAMPLE.COM.
Steps: Submit the otherwise valid registration and inspect the email error and user count.
Expected result: A field error is shown and no second account is created.

Title: Required registration fields
Preconditions and data: Valid adult data; independently blank first name, last name, email, DOB, phone, gender and password.
Steps: Submit each missing-field variant and inspect form errors and database count.
Expected result: Each missing required value has a field error; no account is persisted.

Title: Invalid registration values
Preconditions and data: Otherwise valid data; invalid email/DOB/gender, blood group C+, and non-phone text.
Steps: Submit each invalid value independently.
Expected result: Invalid choices and contact values are rejected without creating a user.

Title: Registration cannot grant privileges
Preconditions and data: Public donor registration with extra role=ADMIN, is_staff=true and is_superuser=true.
Steps: Submit and reload the stored account.
Expected result: Stored role remains DONOR and neither staff nor superuser permission is granted.

Title: Safe inline registration errors
Preconditions and data: Valid data except an under-age DOB.
Steps: Submit and inspect the returned form HTML.
Expected result: Non-secret fields are preserved, the DOB error is associated with its field, and the password is not echoed.

Title: Registration rollback after insert failure
Preconditions and data: Valid form; inject a failure immediately after User.save inserts the account.
Steps: Save the form, catch the simulated exception and query users.
Expected result: The account insert is rolled back; no partial account remains.

Title: Email and username authentication
Preconditions and data: Active approved donor with known password and email.
Steps: Log in using mixed-case email, then log out and log in using username.
Expected result: Both supported identifiers authenticate the correct account.

Title: Invalid credentials
Preconditions and data: Registered donor; wrong password and missing credential variants.
Steps: Submit each invalid login and inspect session authentication state.
Expected result: Login fails without an authenticated session.

Title: Role destinations
Preconditions and data: Active approved DONOR, HOSPITAL, STAFF and ADMIN accounts.
Steps: Authenticate separately with each role.
Expected result: Each account reaches its configured role destination.

Title: Inactive and unapproved accounts
Preconditions and data: Known correct donor credentials; independently disable is_active and is_approved.
Steps: Attempt login for each disabled state.
Expected result: The response does not establish an authenticated session.

Title: Unsafe return URLs
Preconditions and data: Valid credentials; external, scheme-relative, javascript and insecure HTTP next URLs.
Steps: Log in with each next target.
Expected result: Unsafe targets are ignored and the permitted role destination is used.

Title: Secure session cookie configuration
Preconditions and data: Successful login through a simulated HTTPS Django request.
Steps: Inspect the session cookie and configured lifetime.
Expected result: Secure and HttpOnly are true, SameSite is Lax, and explicit expiry/max-age is 1800 seconds. This does not verify deployed TLS.

Title: Activity renews inactivity expiry
Preconditions and data: Authenticated session with shortened stored expiry.
Steps: Request an interactive protected page; reload the session expiry.
Expected result: The server expiry renews to approximately 30 minutes and the cookie is renewed.

Title: Expired session denial
Preconditions and data: Authenticated session whose stored expiry is moved into the past.
Steps: Request a protected HTML page and then a JSON-accepting protected request.
Expected result: HTML redirects to login, JSON receives 401, and authentication is absent.

Title: Logout and stale cookie replay
Preconditions and data: Authenticated donor; retain the original session key.
Steps: POST logout. Try the old key from a fresh client against a protected page.
Expected result: Logout deletes the stored session and replay cannot restore access. This covers the logout portion of TC-AUTH-02; reset belongs to #45.

Title: Login/logout CSRF
Preconditions and data: Client with CSRF enforcement enabled; HTTPS requests.
Steps: POST login and logout without tokens; then submit logout with a valid token and same-origin referer.
Expected result: Missing tokens receive 403; a valid authenticated logout succeeds.

Title: Session fixation prevention
Preconditions and data: Anonymous session exists before successful authentication.
Steps: Log in and compare old/new keys and persisted sessions.
Expected result: The key rotates and the pre-login key is deleted.

Title: Own profile and next date
Preconditions and data: Signed-in donor with registered profile fields and a prior collection.
Steps: Open the donor profile and compare displayed details and next date to persisted data.
Expected result: Only the selected authorized donor profile is shown with the calculated next date.

Title: Permitted profile edits preserve laboratory data
Preconditions and data: Signed-in donor; donor self-reported group differs from a collected unit laboratory group.
Steps: Submit permitted profile edits and reload donor and unit.
Expected result: Permitted profile fields change; protected fields and the laboratory blood group do not.

Title: Private ordered donation history
Preconditions and data: Two donors with collections, including distinct Bag IDs and collection dates.
Steps: Open the current donor history and inspect order and collection details.
Expected result: Only that donor collections appear in the expected order with relevant collection details.

Title: Cross-donor profile isolation
Preconditions and data: Signed-in donor; another donor ID and a missing ID.
Steps: Request both IDs through donor-facing profile/history access.
Expected result: The donor cannot access another person data or distinguish missing accounts through the protected route.

Title: Staff read-only donor review
Preconditions and data: Existing donor and authenticated STAFF/ADMIN reviewers.
Steps: Read donor details, then attempt a profile edit as the reviewer.
Expected result: Authorized review succeeds while editing donor-owned profile fields is denied.

Title: Default interval and exact boundary
Preconditions and data: Fixed clock; latest original collection 10 days ago, an older collection, and a separate exactly-90-day fixture.
Steps: Compute donation_summary for both scenarios.
Expected result: Next date is latest collection plus the configured default 90 days; the exact boundary is eligible by interval.

Title: Components are not extra donations
Preconditions and data: Original donation, derived component, future collection and another donor collection.
Steps: Compute the donor donation summary.
Expected result: Only the donor original non-future collection counts toward history and interval.

Title: Discarded collection still counts
Preconditions and data: A recent original collection is Discarded.
Steps: Calculate the donor interval summary.
Expected result: Discard does not undo the physical donation or reset the donor waiting interval.

Title: Stored markup is escaped
Preconditions and data: Donor profile with stored markup in a displayed field.
Steps: Render the profile page and inspect response HTML.
Expected result: Stored markup appears as escaped text rather than executable HTML.

Title: Malformed or privileged profile API edits
Preconditions and data: Authenticated donor; invalid phone/group and role/id/email/password changes.
Steps: PUT each invalid payload to /api/donors/me and reload the account.
Expected result: Each unsupported/privileged edit receives 400 and persisted identity/role/contact remain unchanged.

Title: Interval and medical screening are distinct
Preconditions and data: Recent donation and Eligible medical screening; another donor without screening.
Steps: Read /api/donors/me/eligibility for both donors.
Expected result: A passing screening does not bypass the waiting interval; absent screening does not imply overall eligibility.

Title: Quarantine queue and elapsed time
Preconditions and data: Staff; Quarantined unit collected two days ago, Available/Discarded/expired comparison units.
Steps: Open the quarantine queue.
Expected result: Only the quarantined unit appears, elapsed time is 2.0 days, count is one and response is no-store.

Title: History survives leaving quarantine
Preconditions and data: Quarantined unit; staff changes it to Discarded with a reason.
Steps: Read HTML and JSON history, then reopen the queue.
Expected result: Old/new states, actor, timestamp and reason remain available; the unit leaves the current quarantine queue.

Title: Unsafe and expired stock exclusion
Preconditions and data: One safe available B+ unit and Quarantined, Discarded and overdue units.
Steps: Read public availability and staff inventory counts.
Expected result: Only the safe available unit contributes; public output does not expose staff identity.

Title: Quarantine authorization
Preconditions and data: Donor, hospital and anonymous clients.
Steps: Attempt quarantine/history HTML and API reads.
Expected result: Donor/hospital receive 403; anonymous HTML redirects to login and anonymous API receives 401.

Title: Persisted status transition metadata
Preconditions and data: Quarantined unit and authenticated staff; reason Storage issue.
Steps: Save transition to Discarded and inspect StatusChange.
Expected result: History stores actual previous/new states, staff and server timestamp with reason; quarantine timestamp is cleared.

Title: Re-entry resets quarantine clock
Preconditions and data: Previously cleared unit; remove one required result in the controlled fixture.
Steps: Re-evaluate at fixed time; inspect quarantine duration 12 hours later.
Expected result: Current-entry timestamp resets and duration is 0.5 days, rather than age since original collection.

Title: Audit failure rolls back status and panel
Preconditions and data: Quarantined unit; simulate failure writing StatusChange.
Steps: Record a complete passing panel and catch the failure; reload unit and results.
Expected result: Status stays Quarantined, no panel results persist, and only the initial history entry remains.

Title: Bulk status updates cannot bypass history
Preconditions and data: Existing unit with structured status history.
Steps: Attempt queryset update and bulk_update of status.
Expected result: Unsupported bulk status changes are rejected rather than silently losing history.

Title: Append-only status history
Preconditions and data: Existing StatusChange record.
Steps: Try editing/deleting history through supported model/queryset entry points.
Expected result: Mutation attempts are rejected and retained history is unchanged.

Title: Unique pending requisitions
Preconditions and data: Active approved hospital; valid group/component, positive quantity, required-by date.
Steps: Submit two requisitions and inspect their initial events.
Expected result: Unique request IDs, Pending status, correct owner/remaining quantity and submission actor/server time are persisted.

Title: Unapproved or inactive hospital submission
Preconditions and data: Hospital account independently set unapproved or inactive.
Steps: Attempt browser requisition submission in each state.
Expected result: Submission is denied without creating a requisition.

Title: Request input validation and atomic audit
Preconditions and data: Approved hospital; quantity 0/-1/true/1.5, invalid group/component/STAT type or past required-by date.
Steps: Submit each variant; then simulate submission-event failure for valid data.
Expected result: Invalid input persists no request; event failure also rolls back the request.

Title: Staff approve/reject decisions
Preconditions and data: Pending requests; authorized staff and a rejection reason.
Steps: Approve one request, reject another, inspect events.
Expected result: Decision status, responsible actor and rejection reason are recorded.

Title: Hospital ownership isolation
Preconditions and data: Two hospitals, one request belonging to the first.
Steps: As the second hospital, attempt detail access and review.
Expected result: Foreign detail is hidden and unauthorized review cannot mutate the request.

Title: Stale review cannot overwrite priority change
Preconditions and data: Pending request version 0; owner changes its priority.
Steps: Review using version 0, then review using the current version.
Expected result: Stale review conflicts; current-version approval succeeds.

Title: Malformed request JSON
Preconditions and data: Authenticated hospital; malformed JSON, wrong types, invalid fields/dates.
Steps: POST invalid bodies to /api/requests/.
Expected result: Invalid requests receive 400 without persisting invalid data.

Title: STAT ordering and alert counts
Preconditions and data: One ordinary and two STAT pending requests.
Steps: Read the staff queue and pending summary; approve one STAT request and read again.
Expected result: STAT requests precede ordinary requests in deterministic order; pending alert count decreases after review.

Title: Live STAT alert response
Preconditions and data: Staff queue open; another client submits a STAT request.
Steps: Read the alert endpoint without reloading the full page.
Expected result: The response includes the new pending STAT request. Endpoint correctness is automated; visual refresh timing requires the manual check below.

Title: Passive polling cannot keep idle login alive
Preconditions and data: Authenticated staff session; simulated 29-minute and 31-minute inactivity.
Steps: Poll alerts at both times and compare stored expiry/cookies.
Expected result: The first poll does not renew expiry; after inactivity limit the poll receives 401 and clears the expired cookie.

Title: Receipt identity, custody and counts
Preconditions and data: Owning approved hospital; two dispatched bags on a fulfilled request.
Steps: Confirm one bag, inspect receipt/status/history/counts, then confirm the other.
Expected result: Selected bag becomes Delivered with authenticated receiver/server time; other bag stays Dispatched until confirmed. Dispatch fulfilment and available counts do not change.

Title: Receipt does not complete an under-supplied request
Preconditions and data: Request for two units with only one dispatched.
Steps: Confirm receipt of the dispatched bag.
Expected result: Request remains Partially Fulfilled with one dispatched and one outstanding.

Title: Duplicate/stale/mixed receipt batches
Preconditions and data: Two dispatched bags; first already confirmed; retain an old request version.
Steps: Try repeat receipt, mixed confirmed/unconfirmed batch and stale-version receipt.
Expected result: Each conflicts atomically; second bag stays Dispatched and no extra receipt/version change occurs.

Title: Only active approved owner can confirm
Preconditions and data: Dispatched bag; foreign hospital, staff, admin, donor and unapproved owner.
Steps: Attempt receipt as each disallowed actor.
Expected result: All are denied and no confirmation is stored.

Title: Unknown/foreign/duplicate/non-dispatched bags
Preconditions and data: Own and foreign requests with bags; empty, wrong-type, duplicate and unknown Bag ID variants.
Steps: Submit each invalid batch; also try a batch containing a now-discarded bag.
Expected result: Invalid batches fail without partial delivery or any receipt records.

Title: Receipt audit failure rollback
Preconditions and data: Dispatched bag; inject requisition event failure.
Steps: Attempt receipt and reload unit, request version, receipts and status history.
Expected result: Bag remains Dispatched, version is unchanged, and no receipt/Delivered history persists.

Title: Tracking and browser receipt
Preconditions and data: Owning hospital and dispatched manifest.
Steps: Open request detail, confirm through HTML, inspect returned tracking JSON and staff view.
Expected result: Bag IDs/manifest appear; receipt renders Delivered and receiver; staff can inspect but cannot use the hospital receipt control.

Title: Canonical delivery endpoint and replay
Preconditions and data: Owning hospital; persisted fulfilment ID and current request version.
Steps: POST to /api/deliveries/{fulfilment_id}/confirm/ twice with the same version.
Expected result: First receives 200, replay receives 409, and exactly one receipt exists.

Title: Integrated partial/full fulfilment reconciliation
Preconditions and data: Real domain services; approved hospital; two safe bags plus quarantined/expired comparisons.
Steps: Request and approve two units. Cross-match, allocate, dispatch and receive one bag at a time; inspect reports/counts/audit.
Expected result: Unsafe stock is excluded; partial then full dispatch state and two Delivered units reconcile with manifests, available count and a valid audit chain.

Title: Real unhandled error and safe logging
Preconditions and data: Controlled test-only URL configuration and captured django.request log.
Steps: Trigger an unhandled exception through the client and inspect response/log record.
Expected result: Safe 500 response and timestamped exception information/stack trace are present; no fault route is added to deployed URLs.
